name: expenditures-control
description: Keeps bank-notification movements in a local SQLite file and answers budget questions by category and month.
long_description: Claude reads your bank notification emails with its own Gmail connector (read-only) and hands this extension only the extracted data: date, amount, merchant, bank, kind. Everything is stored in a SQLite file on your computer (default ~/.gastos-mcp/gastos.db). The extension never touches your email.

tools.name: registrar_movimientos
tools.description: Save up to 100 movements in one batch.

tools.name: consultar_movimientos
tools.description: Filter and group movements (by category, bank, merchant, day or month).

tools.name: clasificar_comercio
tools.description: Assign a category to a merchant and reclassify its expenses.

tools.name: fijar_presupuesto
tools.description: Set the budget of a category for a month (or the default).

tools.name: estado_presupuesto
tools.description: Spent vs budget per category, with an alert at 80%.

tools.name: importar_gastos_fijos
tools.description: Load the fixed-expenses list from an Excel file.

tools.name: gastos_fijos_pendientes
tools.description: Fixed expenses of the month: paid and still due.

tools.name: ultimo_movimiento_registrado
tools.description: Most recent movement date per bank.

tools.name: listar_remitentes
tools.description: List authorized bank senders and the Gmail query to use.

tools.name: filtrar_no_registrados
tools.description: From a list of message ids, return those not registered yet.
